##### Project general facts

Azizi Riviera 56 is envisioned as a refined residential destination in the prestigious Meydan district, offering a serene waterfront lifestyle complemented by exceptional urban connectivity. Designed for individuals and families seeking comfort, elegance, and long-term convenience, the development combines contemporary architecture with a calm coastal atmosphere. Its strategic position within Meydan One grants residents immediate access to entertainment venues, leisure destinations, dining experiences, and essential services while remaining closely connected to major landmarks such as Downtown Dubai, DIFC, and Dubai International Airport.

Within its thoughtfully planned community, Azizi Riviera 56 presents a selection of studio to 3-bedroom apartments crafted to maximize natural light and embrace panoramic waterfront views. Scenic promenades, landscaped green spaces, and inviting communal zones enrich the everyday experience, while amenities such as swimming pools, fitness facilities, playgrounds, and social areas create a well-balanced lifestyle environment. The project stands as a sophisticated blend of coastal tranquility, urban accessibility, and architectural refinement.

Residences at Azizi Riviera 56 are delivered fully furnished, featuring a contemporary interior palette defined by premium finishes and soft neutral tones. Floor-to-ceiling windows enhance natural light, while high-quality materials introduce a sense of understated luxury throughout the living spaces. Kitchens come fully fitted, equipped with modern appliances and sleek cabinetry designed for both functionality and aesthetic cohesion. Bathrooms incorporate refined fixtures, elegant surfaces, and clean minimalistic detailing. Each unit is curated to create a harmonious, move-in-ready home that blends comfort, sophistication, and modern convenience.

##### Location description and benefits

Mohammed Bin Rashid City (MBR City) is a massive urban development project includes high-end residential properties, such as villas, mansions, and luxury apartments, catering to affluent individuals and families. The architecture and design of these properties often feature modern and contemporary styles, incorporating the latest technological advancements and sustainable practices.

The city also boasts a range of world-class amenities and attractions. These include vast green spaces, parks, and landscaped gardens, providing residents and visitors with opportunities for leisure and relaxation. The project includes the Dubai Canal, an impressive waterway that flows through the heart of MBR City, adding to the aesthetic appeal and offering waterfront living experiences.

Furthermore, MBR City is home to several entertainment and cultural landmarks. One notable example is the Dubai Hills Estate, a luxury golf course community that features an 18-hole championship golf course, high-end residential properties, and a range of retail and dining options. Other planned attractions within MBR City include theme parks, art galleries, museums, and sports facilities.
